name: smartdoc
description: Review your documents with Claude in the SmartDoc app, and decide on each suggestion yourself.
long_description: SmartDoc shows your document (a PDF) in a desktop app on your computer. Claude reads it and either suggests improvements, which you accept, reject or answer in the app before it writes the next draft from your decisions, or picks out the key information for what you need to know. The app opens automatically when Claude needs it; it's downloaded from the project's GitHub release the first time. Your document stays on your computer: only what Claude reads through these tools goes to Claude.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Documents you've opened in SmartDoc before, so Claude can open one again.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Opens a document in SmartDoc: one you've opened before, a PDF you confirm in the app, or a file you pick.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: The open document's size and shape: pages, word and paragraph counts, its outline and details, page by page.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: The text of the open document, whole or a range of pages.

tools.name: find_text
tools.description: Finds a word or phrase in the open document, with the page and surrounding text of each match.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: The current draft's review: your requests, the findings with your decisions, annotations and history.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Earlier reviews of your document and what you decided on each finding, so a new review doesn't ask again.

tools.name: start_review
tools.description: Starts a review of the current draft: suggesting improvements, or highlighting the key information for your goal.

tools.name: add_annotation
tools.description: Highlights, underlines or strikes through text in the document.

tools.name: add_finding
tools.description: Adds a finding for you to decide on: a change, a choice of options, a question, a structural or design change, or a note.

tools.name: add_highlight
tools.description: Picks out a piece of key information for what you're looking for, or something the document doesn't say.

tools.name: remove_highlight
tools.description: Removes a highlight from the open highlights review.

tools.name: remove_finding
tools.description: Removes a finding from the open review.

tools.name: commit_review
tools.description: Finishes the review, so you can decide on its findings or read its highlights in the app.

tools.name: get_decisions
tools.description: Your decisions on the current review.

tools.name: apply_review
tools.description: Writes the next draft of the document from the changes you accepted.
